title: Launch Broadcast, Run of Show (4 hours, solo host)

source.note: The SOURCE OF WORDS. Every on_screen, host_beat, cta, never_say and contingency string in this file is VERBATIM from that document. Nothing is paraphrased. viewer/firstrun_data.json paraphrased all 21 cues while its own header said it must not be paraphrased, renamed a real site route from 'the living gate' to 'the open gate' to slip past the overlay fence, and dropped 'natural, not artificial' from the GNI line. This file exists partly so that never happens again.

_why_this_file: The 2026-07-17 rundown is CONTENT-TRUE and MACHINERY-FALSE. Measured 2026-07-29: every website
route it names resolves, every playlist id resolves, every price is exact, the DOI is right.
But its six camera words -- BROWSER, TITLE, COLONY-LIVE, COLONY-CLIP, LAB-LIVE, CHAT -- match
ZERO of the 32 selectable scenes the studio actually has, and the copy embedded at
viewer/infra.html drives nothing: it makes three fetches, none to the studio, and clicking a row
writes localStorage and swaps teleprompter text. This file binds every row to a REAL scene and a
REAL route so the rundown can drive the show instead of describing one.

It is reachable ONLY by /api/camlayout {layout:'pip'} whose default branch CUTS TO AIR (command_center.cjs:1618,1624-1625). THE ONE SCENE YOU CANNOT PREVIEW IS REACHABLE ONLY BY PUTTING IT ON AIR. rules.never_use_api_cut: /api/cut (command_center.cjs:1600) takes ANY string and puts it straight on air with NO validation. /api/preview (:1585) validates against allTemplates() and 400s on an unknown scene. THE SAFE ROUTE IS FENCED AND THE DANGEROUS ONE IS NOT. Every row here is driven preview-then-take, never cut.
rules.preview_then_take: POST /api/preview {scene} -> look at it -> POST /api/take. The operator has said he needs to see what will happen before it does; this is that, mechanically.
rules.undo: POST /api/back returns to the previous program scene. Every row is reversible.
rules.csrf: Every mutating route requires header x-uni-cc: 1 and content-type: application/json, loopback peer only (the house standard, command_center.cjs:1579).
rules.advancing_is_not_going_live: Nothing in this rundown can start a stream. Going to air is POST /api/golive, which passes through viewer/golive_guard.cjs and refuses all seven paths for want of a presence token nothing in the repository mints. An advance changes what is on PROGRAM inside an already-running (or not-running) stream. It never starts one.
rules.speech_is_not_fenced: The overlay fence at command_center.cjs:313 guards /api/overlay -- the SUPER. It does not and cannot guard the host's mouth. A line the fence refuses may still be SAID, and this show is built on saying them.

fence_collisions_measured.how_tested: The FENCE regex was read out of command_center.cjs:313 and applied to every line locally. Nothing was POSTed.

L4.text: Passing a gate demonstrates the named behaviour, never experience.
L4.why_this_is_the_hard_one: L4 is the show's most-used strap and the fence refuses it. The fence cannot tell a CLAIM from a DENIAL: 'never experience' is a refusal to claim experience, and /experienc\w*/ catches the word regardless of polarity. This is use-versus-mention at the broadcast layer -- the same defect class this programme has been caught by repeatedly.
L4.resolution_in_this_rundown: L4 IS SPOKEN, NOT SUPERED, in all four segments -- which the source document already instructs at 1.3 ('F1 fence, read it'). The super for those rows is a strap that passes the fence. NO WORD OF L4 IS CHANGED. Rewriting it is what produced 'the open gate'.
L4.the_operator_may_overturn_this: fenceCheck(text, force) at command_center.cjs:314 ALREADY takes a force parameter, so L4 could be supered verbatim under an explicit authorised force with a recorded reason. That is his call, not an agent's, because it is a decision about what this show puts on screen.

honesty_card_cells_refused.why_it_does_not_matter: The honesty card is a SECOND-MONITOR ARTEFACT -- the source says 'keep this on the second monitor'. It is never sent to /api/overlay, so the fence never sees it. It is listed here only so nobody later mistakes a card cell for a super.
honesty_card_cells_refused.correction_to_an_earlier_claim: An audit of this show reported '18 of 148 lines refused by the fence'. That count included HOST BEATS and NEVER-SAY lines, which are spoken and never supered. Measured against the surface the fence actually guards, it is ONE lower-third.

rows.title: Cold open and welcome
rows.scene_why: WEB_HOST is 'a web page (defaults to the master-plan board) full-frame + you in the corner' -- the home page with you present. Then CAM_A, 'solo presenter, full frame', for the promises. The source asks for 'your face or a still title card'; the title card has no source, so CAM_A carries it.
rows.on_screen: home page, calm. Then your face or a still title card.
host_beats: Three slow breaths before you speak. Let the room settle.
"Welcome. We are building something in the open, and today we open the doors."
Name the frame plainly: this is a working hypothesis on an attainable path toward General Natural Intelligence, natural not artificial, tested in the open.
Say what this is NOT: not a product demo, not a hype reel, not a claim that anything is solved. "We are going to show you the work, the tests it could fail, and where it still might."
Set the three promises of the next four hours: the science and the tests, why it might matter for being human, and an open invitation to come learn and build.
The one rule of the stream: "Do not take anything I say on faith. The record is open, and so is the invitation. Try to break it."
rows.cta: none yet, point to the pinned comment

rows.title: what UNI is
rows.scene_why: WEB_SIDE is 'you and a web page side-by-side. Walk the roadmap / a site together' -- the shape of explaining a page rather than presenting it.
host_beats: "UNI is our work in active inference. A lens, not a product."
Plain-language mechanism: a system that perceives, learns, and acts by keeping the gap small between what it expects and what the world gives it.
The objective is expected free energy, an epistemic term (reduce uncertainty) plus a pragmatic term (move toward preferred outcomes).

The honest anchor, say it slowly: "No reward, no reinforcement learning, no backprop. No score, no return, no fitness on any learner-facing path. That is not a slogan. It is a property we checked in code."
Cite Parr, Pezzulo and Friston (2022) as the research line this sits in.
rows.cta: "The paper is public. Read it and argue with it."
rows.asset: mention UNI the vision (playlist in the Reading Room) as the way to go deeper later.
rows.never_say: intelligence in the AI sense, thinking, understanding.

rows.title: the benchmark built to fail in public
rows.route_warning: THE ROUTE IS /science/the-living-gate AND THE HOST SHOULD SAY 'the living gate'. viewer/firstrun_data.json renamed it 'the open gate' -- an unannounced rewrite of a real URL to slip the word 'living' past the overlay fence. The page exists at that path. Say the real name; just do not SUPER it.
host_beats: The Stratified Palimpsest: a hard sandbox with opaque senses and a no-leak monitor, so the agent cannot cheat by reading the answer.
Why a benchmark you can fail is the point: "A claim you cannot break is just a slogan. So we wrote ours down, with the test that would prove it wrong."
Show the living gate: a bet registered in public before the run. Evidence first, discrete verdicts, receipts.
rows.spoken_fence: Passing a gate demonstrates the named behaviour, never experience.

rows.title: the colony agent, live
rows.scene_why: COLONY is 'the Minecraft colony world, full frame -- the hero shot. No camera.' Open there and let it breathe, then CAM_PIP ('colony hero + you as a small picture-in-picture. Narrate the world') to narrate without leaving the world.
rows.live_status_2026_07_29: The colony is genuinely running -- GET colony.uni-lab.local:4000/producer/health returned verdict LIVE, driver producer, colony_count 5, with the frame counter advancing between two timed reads. BUT verify_colony FAILS: RCON 25575 and Minecraft 25565 are unreachable from THINKER. The world runs and the studio cannot talk to it.
rows.on_screen: the live colony agent acting in a real game world.
host_beats: "This is a colony agent acting in a real game world, driven by the same engine, no scripted rules and no reward."
Narrate what is actually happening on screen in mechanical terms: the inner loop is landing real actions, the body is doing work in the world.

State the honest status out loud, do not skip this: "The mechanism is demonstrated and reproducible. Whether a hunger-like drive reliably turns into foraging is the hypothesis we are testing right now. Several behavioural gates are still in flight. I will not tell you that is settled, because it is not."

F1 fence, read it: "Passing a gate demonstrates the named behaviour, never experience." The colony does not see, want, or feel. Those are our words for our own comfort, and we keep them out of the math.
rows.spoken_fence: Passing a gate demonstrates the named behaviour, never experience.
rows.never_say: it wants food, it is hungry (as literal claims), it decided, it is alive.
rows.contingency: if the live view drops, cut to the recorded colony clip and say "here is a capture from earlier, same engine," then continue.
rows.contingency_asset_status: MISSING -- no staged clip found on disk. If it is still missing at air time, fall back to contingency_scene (COLONY_SIDE, 'you and the colony side-by-side') and narrate, or contingency_scene_2 (STANDBY). Do not narrate the drop as a failure of the science (source, verbatim intent).

rows.title: the fence first
rows.on_screen: /science (scroll to the non-clinical lines), then a plain title card.
host_beats: Open with the fence, do not bury it: "What follows is a design and modeling lens, not a clinical or diagnostic tool. Nothing here is medical advice, and nothing here is a diagnosis. If you are in crisis, please reach a professional or a local helpline."

The idea, in the gentlest true form: "The same math that keeps an agent's expectations close to the world is a way to think about how a person can lower the fear of the present so the future feels safe to explore."
Keep the subject the person, never the company, never a promise to fix anyone.

rows.title: you are not broken
rows.scene_why: CLIP_SIDE is 'a YouTube clip and you side-by-side. React to a video as it plays' for the introduction; CLIP is 'a YouTube clip, full frame. Carries its own audio' for watching the short in silence, which the row asks for.

The core line, say it and let it sit: "You are not broken. The world around the loop is too small."
Frame it as an invitation to a different reading of a hard moment, not a prescription. "Small films for the moment someone decides whether they are the problem. They are not."
Watch one short together, in silence, then a slow breath.
rows.cta: "The films are free. Share them with someone who needs the reminder."

rows.never_say: this will help your trauma, guaranteed relief.

host_beats: The mission in the plain register: grow the world, grow it together, no one left outside.

rows.title: Close
rows.on_screen: a calm title card, then your face.
host_beats: Recap the three promises kept: you saw the science and the tests it could fail, you heard why it might matter for a person, and the door is open.

Restate the honest frame one last time: "A working hypothesis on an attainable path toward General Natural Intelligence, natural not artificial, tested in the open. Growing evidence, gates still in flight, nothing hidden."
The invitation, in the anthem register (do not quote the song lyrics, just carry the calm): grow the world, grow it together, no one left outside.

passes the fence, no row can start a stream. They are NOT counted in the 240, because the source
run of show is a four-hour programme and quietly spending 93 minutes of it on a pre-roll would
make the clock a lie while leaving it arithmetically green.
The operator goes to air, runs this block, and is on camera live at the end of it. The show's
EVERY ROW HERE DECLARES ITS SOURCE, and verify_rundown.cjs refuses a CLIP row whose source is not
playable. A row that calls for a film with no mechanism to play it is a row that fails at air
time, on camera -- which is the failure this whole file exists to prevent.
